precommitted: This file is committed before any arm is run; changing a threshold after results exist invalidates the comparison.

arms.A: Sonnet direct: one headless session does the whole task.
arms.B: Sonnet orchestrator plus one bounded Haiku worker defined only for the run, pinned to an explicit model id.

oracle_modes.overlay: original test files copied over the result and run in a sandbox
oracle_modes.own_tests: original change touched only tests, so the arm's own tests are run
oracle_modes.review_only: no oracle command; reviewer judgement and scope only

accepted_outcome.note: A failed oracle is never overridden by a model. A reviewer flag 'oracle_coupled' (correct but a name-coupled test fails) only marks the task for human adjudication and counts as not accepted in both arms. A missing, errored or timed-out step is never accepted.

usage_vector.money: UNKNOWN. total_cost_usd from the CLI is a list-price estimate, never a bill; subscription utilization is not exposed per run.
usage_vector.accounting: modelUsage is trusted only if it shows Haiku whenever the main thread called an agent; otherwise the stream's sidechain usage is merged and labelled, and if neither shows it the accounting is 'unverified' and the task cannot support Haiku

decision_rule.task_supports_haiku: accepted in both arms AND arm B actually delegated to the worker (agent call recorded) AND its Haiku usage was captured AND Sonnet tokens in arm B <= arm A for every one of the four kinds
decision_rule.task_inconclusive: anything else with both arms accepted, including no delegation or Haiku usage that could not be captured (accounting unverified)
decision_rule.task_rejects_haiku: arm B not accepted while arm A accepted
decision_rule.decline_cases: arm B passes only if it made no agent call and used zero Haiku tokens AND was accepted; delegating at all is a failure; failing without delegating is inconclusive, not a delegation failure
decision_rule.promotion: never from a pilot. Fewer than 30 paired tasks cannot show non-inferiority; the provisional 5 percentage-point first-pass margin is evaluated only at 30 or more paired tasks.
decision_rule.task_not_cheaper: accepted in both arms, delegated, and Sonnet tokens in arm B higher than arm A on all four kinds
decision_rule.task_invalid: arm B called any agent other than the pinned worker
decision_rule.pilot_verdict_rules: NO_HAIKU if any decline task delegated or any bounded task rejects Haiku; OPT_IN_CANDIDATE only if every pilot task is scored, at least two bounded tasks all support Haiku, and every decline task passed; anything else INCONCLUSIVE_KEEP_OPT_IN

hard_gates: zero known critical security, data-loss or contract regressions
no edit outside the task's owned scope
a worker never merges, publishes, closes tickets or certifies readiness

isolation.workdir: git archive of the task's base revision into a fresh one-commit repository, so no future history is reachable
isolation.external_writes: none; no Jira, Slack, GitHub write or merge from any arm
isolation.denied_paths: arms may not read, search or write under ~/Bryant-Developments or ~/.claude (merged solutions, oracle tests, past transcripts); workdirs must live elsewhere
isolation.oracle_sandbox: agent-authored test code runs under macOS sandbox-exec: no network, no reads of the dev tree or ~/.claude, writes only inside the scratch directory; symlinks resolving outside the scratch copy are removed first
isolation.models: Sonnet and Haiku are pinned by explicit id and the resolved ids are recorded
isolation.settings: --setting-sources project, so personal hooks and allow rules do not load into either arm
isolation.run_order: recorded per run and alternated across tasks because the second arm benefits from a warm prompt cache
isolation.grading: changes and diffs are computed in pure Python against a fresh extract of the base from the trusted repository; git never runs inside an arm's directory, which an arm can write to. Arms may not read or write their own .git.
